tools.name: get_brale_overview
tools.description: Get a structured overview of Brale: what the platform does, key capabilities, and links to the API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, docs, and pricing.

tools.name: list_supported_stablecoins
tools.description: List the stablecoins Brale lists and the chains they are deployed on (name, symbol, chain, contract address).

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a key Brale page (e.g. pricing, platform, stablecoins, docs, or book a demo).

destination.description: The page to open. Options: "home" → Brale home (https://brale.xyz/); "platform" → Platform overview (https://brale.xyz/platform); "pricing" → Pricing (https://brale.xyz/pricing); "stablecoins" → Stablecoins hub (https://brale.xyz/stablecoins); "ecosystem" → Ecosystem (https://brale.xyz/ecosystem); "blog" → Blog (https://brale.xyz/blog); "about" → About Brale (https://brale.xyz/about); "careers" → Careers (https://brale.xyz/careers); "contact" → Book a demo (https://brale.xyz/contact); "docs" → Developer documentation (https://docs.brale.xyz/).
